Introduction

Son Jin Wook is a South Korean rock singer known for his wide vocal range, versatility, and incredibly powerful high notes. He is the vocalist of the five-member alternative rock/metal band DANGGISIO, which debuted in 2015 with the single “Rope”, followed by two EPs: “Moonlight” and “Last Dream" and the band FIRR that debuted in 2025 with the single "High ’n‘ Low".

In 2021, Jinwook participated in the survival show Superband 2, but was controversially eliminated by the judges in the second round, sparking a strong backlash from viewers. Later that year, he joined another competition, Kookmin Singer (Tomorrow's National Singer), where he achieved much better results. Although the producers also appeared unfavorable to him, he once again captured the audience’s hearts, advanced to the finals, and finished in 7th place. This led to his official solo debut with the single “Paradigm”, and a long-term role as a regular performer on TV CHOSUN’s show The Nation Calls. Performing a wide variety of audience-requested songs helped him further refine his skills and expand his mastery across multiple genres. At the end of 2022, he also gained recognition by winning on the mystery music show King of Mask Singer (episodes 186–190).

Alongside his solo career, Jinwook launched his official fan café At The Sparkling, and his fandom was officially named Klings. In 2023, he created an official YouTube channel, sharing both original songs and a wide range of vocal covers. At he end of the year started working for BTN RADIO’s as a DJ of Mate ON broadcast and a regular singer on live events.

In 2024 he released four new original singles and made his musical theater debut in the lead role of Santiago in the rock musical "Natural Born Idiots", based on the popular manhwa of the same name.

In 2025 he won the Best Vocals Award at the 15th Pyeongtaek Band Contest, where he competed with FIRR against 232 other bands from all around the South Korea.
